scope: Local isolated fixtures; no production Lightning, market pricing, merchant convenience or service independence claim.

failed_preimage_parsing: LND supplied 32 zero bytes on failure. They were classified as absent only after SHA256 did not match the invoice hash; a nonzero or matching-zero preimage is not accepted as absent.

Not a proof of total-device-loss recovery

No proof of LSPS1 purchase with the bundled provider
